[FACT] User is looking to improve volleyball skills, specifically serves.  
[FACT] User's volleyball team is named 'Net Ninjas'.  
[FACT] User's volleyball team has lost 2 games in the local recreational volleyball league.  
[PREFERENCE] User wants to increase accuracy and power in their serves.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant offered to help improve serves and assist the Net Ninjas in bouncing back in the league.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provided tips for increasing accuracy and power in serves, including:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Stance and Footwork: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, dominant foot forward, weight evenly distributed.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Toss: Hold the ball in the non-dominant hand, toss 6-8 feet in the air, aim for a spot just in front of the dominant eye.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. Contact: Make contact at the peak of the toss, using wrist and forearm to generate power.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 4. Follow-Through: Follow through with arm and body, keeping eyes on the ball.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Tips for improving accuracy include focusing on the target, using eyes to track the ball, practicing different angles, and serving with a purpose.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Tips for improving power include using legs for power, snapping the wrist, strong follow-through, and practicing with resistance.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Mental focus tips include building confidence, focusing on the process, and using positive self-talk.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Practice tips include practicing regularly, filming oneself, and serving with a partner.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provided solo serve drills:  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] Drill 1: Toss and Catch - Toss the ball 6-8 feet in the air and catch it with the non-dominant hand.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] Drill 2: Wall Toss - Toss the ball against a wall, aiming for a height of 6-8 feet.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] Drill 3: Serve Target Practice - Set up a target area on a wall and practice serving to it.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] Drill 4: Power Serve Practice - Serve with maximum power to a distant target.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] Drill 5: Serve with Resistance - Use resistance bands or a medicine ball while serving.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] Drill 6: Serve with Eyes Closed - Practice serving with eyes closed to focus on technique.
